{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Primeday''' was the first [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Galactic Standard]] [[Standard week/Legends|week]] used on<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On Primedays, the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] sold [[Ranat's cheese soup]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] as its daily [[Soup/Legends|soup]] option. The diner also sold a [[nuna salad sandwich]] with a cup of soup for 6.1 credits and a [[Kommerken steak/Legends|kommerken flank steak]] with steamed [[ootoowerg]] for 8.7 credits as part of its lunch and dinner specials on Primedays.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> Primeday shared its name with [[Rozatta's on Primeday]], a franchised [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting agency that operated during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oh, and I also got to establish the days of the week. That's probably something to be proud of, isn't it? From now on out, I'm going to always wonder if, say, Anakin Skywalker became Darth Vader on a Centaxday or a Benduday.|Gregory Walker on creating the days of the week|<ref name="Story Behind the Story">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Primeday was created<ref name="Story Behind the Story" /> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
